lavalink.title: Lavalink nodes
lavalink.introBefore: The pool is built from two places: the hardcoded catalogue committed in
lavalink.introAfter: , and the private nodes you add here. Private nodes are stored in the music database — never in the repository — and always get a pool slot ahead of public nodes.
lavalink.privateText: Your own servers. Passwords are sent once, stored in the database, and never returned to the browser.
lavalink.noPrivate: No private nodes yet. Add one below and it joins the pool immediately.
lavalink.addHint: Use the host and port your Lavalink server listens on. TLS is on unless the server is plain HTTP.
lavalink.label: Label (optional)
lavalink.secureHint: Turn off only for a plain-HTTP node
lavalink.orphansText: These nodes are still in the live pool but are no longer configured. Rescan to close them.
lavalink.catalogueText: {count} public nodes ship with the bot in
lavalink.catalogueAfter: . They are read-only here — edit the source to change them.
lavalink.savedAndAdded: {id} was saved and added to the live pool.
lavalink.savedNextRescan: {id} was saved. It will join the pool on the next rescan.
lavalink.saveFailed: The private node could not be saved.
lavalink.removeConfirm:
Remove {id} from the private node list?

Its players are disconnected and the node leaves the pool.
lavalink.removeFailed: The private node could not be removed.
lavalink.rescanning: Probing the catalogue and rescanning the pool…
lavalink.rescanDone: Pool rescan finished. Every node above shows its current state.
lavalink.rescanFailed: The pool could not be rescanned.
